body.name: W_hat_cyc
body.construction: Let \(\widehat m_k\) and \(\widehat C_k\) denote the moment coordinates of \(\widehat z\). For \(i\in\{0,1\}\), set \(\widehat d_i=\widehat m_{i+1}-\widehat m_i\), \(\widehat M_i=(\widehat C_{i+1}-\widehat C_{i+2})(\widehat C_i-\widehat C_{i+1})^{-1}\), and \(\widehat K_i=[\widehat d_i,\widehat M_i\widehat d_i,\ldots,\widehat M_i^{p-1}\widehat d_i]\). Whenever the displayed inverses exist, define \[\widehat W_{\mathrm{cyc}}=\widehat K_1\widehat K_0^{-1}.\]
